content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect calibration of the Voltage Analog-to-Digital Converter (VADC) for temperature channels, which was using a reference voltage of 1.25V instead of the correct VDD reference of 1.875V. Additionally, there was no sufficient delay (200us) between the configuration of the Analog Multiplexer (AMUX) and the start of the ADC conversion, which could lead to inaccurate readings. The patch corrects these issues by setting the appropriate properties and adding the necessary delay.
